fields.description: Valid project, scope, descriptor, snapshot, strict snapshot/artifact evidence references, event, invocation, and checkpoint examples round-trip with stable references and versions

Invalid/unknown versions, extra or duplicate fields, malformed IDs, oversized frames, invalid numeric/range values are rejected before allocation/effect beyond limits; bounded seeded mutation of checked-in valid/invalid byte corpus exercises the real framing codec and typed contract parser, asserting valid-record round-trip/invariants and explicit invalid-input rejection, with saved counterexample replay
Stale patches, hash mismatch, foreign-project evidence and unauthorized identity references are rejected; original evidence remains unchanged
Harness and simulated-runtime consumers obtain identical denials for equivalent calls; revoked grants and child scope/quota escalation cannot admit effects
Four distinct asset/investigation/DAG/trace contracts link correctly; user/session memory examples prefilter ownership and reject third levels/cross-session access
Plain HTTP/1.1 forwarding succeeds with expected method, target, legal duplicate headers, binary body, and captured references
CONNECT establishes an authorized opaque TLS tunnel; receiver bytes are correct and no inspection claim is made
HTTPS HTTP/1.1 interception succeeds with client-local fixture root and independently verified upstream trust; no verification bypass or OS trust change
HTTPS HTTP/2 interception forwards H2 on both legs with ALPN evidence, two concurrent streams, semantic headers and exact unchanged bodies; no H1 downgrade counted as H2
Exclusions, redirect pivots, DNS changes, mapped addresses, and ungranted loopback/private ports deny actual connections; reachable controlled receivers observe zero prohibited effects

Invalid upstream certificates and mismatched CONNECT/SNI/request authorities fail explicitly; client trust can be removed; before/after OS trust records match; secrets/key-log markers absent from prohibited outputs
Oversized/truncated bodies and unsupported protocols/encodings produce their declared bounded behavior; no incomplete replacement, silent corruption, or unsupported inspection claim
Resetting one H2 stream does not corrupt a concurrent valid stream; limits and visible per-stream errors remain attributable
Component built against the public WIT reads permitted chunks and proposes valid ranges without private engine APIs; unchanged input body remains byte-identical
Infinite guest computation is interrupted by configured fuel/epochs/deadline, not by waiting for the guest to cooperate

Excess memory/table/instance growth hits hard per-Store guest limits; simultaneous invocation attempts across distinct component Stores/runners saturate the engine-wide `max_concurrent_invocations` cap and immediately return structured `budget_exhausted` without starting extra work or unbounded queuing; engine/control remain responsive; measured runner RSS behavior is recorded without claiming a hard OS cap
Oversized/invalid observation lists, overflowed offsets, stale snapshots and foreign-project references fail with explicit validated errors

A blocked host body-read operation through the actual broker hits its independent `host_call_deadline_ms`/cancellation even when fuel/epoch interruption alone cannot stop it; concurrent trusted native fixture calls through that broker saturate engine-wide `max_concurrent_host_calls` across component Stores/runners and immediately return structured `budget_exhausted` without performing extra work or unbounded queuing; control remains responsive
Ungranted filesystem/socket/environment/credential imports and access attempts fail; no host directories, CA private keys, or credentials are disclosed

After EACH CMP-02 through CMP-06 adversarial variant, including invocation/host-call saturation and success/trap/timeout/cancellation slot-release paths, all held aggregate slots are released and the engine and a fresh permitted invocation succeed; trace attributes the original failure rather than returning empty success
Simulated adapter starts, consumes scoped context, proposes brokered calls, emits events/results/usage, cancels and closes; separate simulated model boundary makes zero external calls
Effective VM/global configuration, image/version/provision hashes, UID, namespaces, seccomp and controllers are attested; contaminated/missing settings block launch without native fallback
Workload and fork/exec descendants perform real denied reads of host/management/other-invocation canaries and credential paths; a granted snapshot remains readable

Actual IPv4/IPv6 TCP/UDP/DNS, loopback/gateway/target/model, Unix-manager-socket and AF_VSOCK attempts are blocked; reachable observers see zero unauthorized arrivals; inherited descriptors grant no escape
Fork/thread, memory, tmpfs and output floods meet cgroup/size/deadline policy; privilege/namespace/cgroup/descriptor escape attempts fail; host survives and the next valid invocation succeeds

With runtime reads/output blocked and cancellation ignored, host activates/acknowledges the barrier by the profile deadline, denies all later stale calls, and observes child-cgroup termination or recorded VM-stop escalation
Duplicate and late events/results keep original causality/revision, deduplicate effects, and never reactivate obsolete pending work or expand quota
Killing host/SSH transport expires the independent guest lease, terminates descendants, and prevents orphan effects; killing only SSH is not accepted as termination evidence

SIGKILL at both before_reservation_commit and after_reservation_commit (before final admission) restores prior consumption, reconciles/releases any durable unspent reservation, and observes zero receiver POSTs before/after restart without dispatching the old command

SIGKILL at after_sending_commit (before dispatch) and after_receiver_increment (before completion commit) restores `outcome_unknown` even for zero arrivals, preserves consumption, performs only authorized read-only reconciliation, and causes zero additional POSTs
SIGKILL after completion commit, duplicate events, and old lease messages do not duplicate an effect or reset budget; evidence/result references remain consistent
Scope/grant/control changes while the engine is down invalidate incompatible restored work; current versions and identities are checked before any new effect
Full disk, failed sync, damaged ledger, or incompatible checkpoint blocks new admission with visible partial evidence; unknown effects are not guessed safe or blindly resent

Version/decision register records authoritative stable observations, exact resolved pins/checksums/licenses, pilot/TLS/backend/language/persistence choices, hardware/profile, raw measurements and rerun instructions

All five packages and mandatory cases are accounted for with consistent immutable evidence; failed/blocked/unexecuted cases, missing approval or evidence, changed hashes, and unsupported required modes prevent a passing approved exit; no later-phase product/spec is claimed
